description: This is a front-end HTML page for visualizing and browsing databases and their tables in a web application. It provides UI components, styles, and client-side JavaScript logic for interacting with backend APIs to load databases, tables, and table data, with features like refreshing, expandable cells, and responsive layout.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Triggers re-loading of database list and resets UI states.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles expanding/collapsing database entries and loading tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and renders data for a specific table in the main view.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders HTML table with data including handling wide/nested data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for a cell based on its data type and length.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for wide or nested data.
